title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology.


This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.


About Ten16 Creative

Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.


We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.


About the Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.


This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.


You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.


You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.


You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.


Qualifications

The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.


They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

We are seeking a Project Manager to serve as the operational backbone of client delivery, coordinating workflows across creative, media, and retention teams. You will be responsible for managing project timelines, organizing resources, and ensuring seamless communication between internal teams and clients to maintain the high standard of service our partners expect.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of client deliverables and campaign launches
  • Streamlined workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and improve team velocity
  • High client satisfaction scores through proactive communication and organized project management
  • Well-documented processes that scale efficiently as the team and client base grow


Responsibilities

  • Manage project timelines and deliverables across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Coordinate between creative, media buying, retention, and account teams to allocate resources effectively
  • Organize weekly client meeting agendas, take detailed notes, and create actionable task lists from meeting outcomes
  • Create and assign Asana tasks for internal teams based on client requests and monthly retainer deliverables
  • Track creative production pipelines and monitor asset status from brief through completion
  • Build and maintain SOPs for internal processes, organized in Notion
  • Set up and manage client project management tools including Google Drive, Asana, Slack, and creative proofing platforms
  • Lead internal team standups and coordinate cross-functional project kickoffs
  • Handle client onboarding processes and schedule kick-off calls with appropriate stakeholders
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and proactively implement process improvements
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of scope of work for each client account
  • Keep all project stakeholders aligned and informed to ensure client retention and satisfaction


Requirements

  • 4+ years of project management experience in a digital marketing or agency environment
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Familiarity with eCommerce platforms and digital advertising (Facebook Ads, Google Ads, email marketing)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with clients and internal teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Expert proficiency with Google Drive (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
  • Experience with project management and collaboration tools (Asana, Notion, Slack)
  • Ability to work independently while fostering collaborative team relationships


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a digital advertising or eCommerce agency
  • Familiarity with creative production workflows and asset management
  • Experience with Figma, Frame.io, or other creative collaboration tools
  • Background in managing subscription-based or retainer client relationships
  • Process documentation and SOP development experience


Compensation and Benefits

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan : Fully customizable 401(k) with up to 4% company match
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage : Fully-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Wellness Benefits : Complimentary Headspace subscription and fitness stipend
  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Technology Supplied : Equipped with the latest laptop and necessary tools for success
  • Professional Development : Opportunities for growth, training, and expanded responsibilities
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience

title: Senior Performance Governance Analyst (KPI & Service Excellence)

arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno

title: Software Engineer - UI
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer - UI em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Most frontend roles are just building screens.


This isn’t one of them.


This is a chance to own a real-time, collaborative, AI-native product surface - the part of the system where users actually work, make decisions, and rely on the output.


Think Notion or Google Docs-style interaction design, applied to a high-stakes domain where correctness and usability matter.


Why this role is interesting:


  • You’ll own state-heavy, collaborative UI systems , not just components
  • You’ll work on real-time multi-user editing and syncing problems
  • You’ll integrate AI directly into the product experience , not as a bolt-on
  • You’ll join a small, high-performing team with real product traction
  • You’ll have direct influence over product direction and UX standards


This is one of the highest-priority engineering hires on the team right now.


What you’ll be doing:


  • Building rich editing and collaboration experiences (shared editing, commenting, annotation)
  • Designing UI systems where multiple users interact in real time
  • Solving state, sync, and performance challenges across frontend and backend
  • Working closely with product and design to ship fast and iterate
  • Integrating AI workflows into user-facing interfaces


What they’re looking for:


  • 3+ years building complex web applications
  • Strong frontend foundation (React, TypeScript, Next.js)
  • Experience with rich UI, editing flows, or collaborative systems
  • Comfortable owning features end-to-end
  • High bar for product quality and interaction design


Strong signals:


  • ProseMirror, Tiptap, or Yjs
  • Real-time collaboration / multi-user systems
  • Editor or document-based product experience
  • AI or LLM workflows in product interfaces


Comp & setup:


  • Remote (US)
  • Small team, high ownership, fast-moving environment


Why it’s a good move:


If you’ve worked on editor-like or collaboration-heavy products before, this is a rare opportunity to go deeper on:


  • real-time systems
  • complex UI architecture
  • AI-native product design


…and do it in a setting where your work actually defines the product.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado] em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Front End Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Front End Engineer



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience

• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

Buscamos um(a) Especialista SRE com foco em Observabilidade, com sólida experiência em engenharia de confiabilidade, monitoramento de ambientes distribuídos e gestão de incidentes críticos. Um(a) profissional com domínio técnico em ferramentas como Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace, e com profundo conhecimento em práticas modernas de observabilidade, rastreamento distribuído e automação de alertas. Esperamos alguém que atue de forma estratégica, proponha padrões técnicos, eleve a maturidade dos nossos sistemas e dissemine boas práticas de visibilidade, performance e resiliência em toda a organização. O candidato ideal é colaborativo, analítico, orientado a resultados e com forte senso de dono, sempre alinhado aos valores e à visão da empresa.


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:


Como Especialista SRE, essa pessoa será protagonista na evolução da plataforma de observabilidade da Empresa. Trará valor ao consolidar métricas, logs e rastreamentos em soluções robustas, garantindo visibilidade em tempo real, diagnóstico preciso de falhas e resposta eficiente a incidentes. Sua atuação será decisiva para o aumento da confiabilidade dos serviços, redução de indisponibilidades, melhoria contínua da performance e apoio estratégico às áreas de tecnologia e produto. Com sua expertise, teremos uma operação mais preditiva, escalável e resiliente. 


• Liderar a implementação e evolução da plataforma de observabilidade, consolidando logs, métricas e traces.

• Definir, padronizar e manter painéis e alertas para serviços críticos da organização.

• Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade (SLIs, SLOs), orientando decisões técnicas com base em dados.

• Automatizar respostas a alertas e reduzir o toil por meio de scripts e integrações entre ferramentas.

• Atuar na gestão de incidentes: triagem, coordenação de resolução, documentação e melhoria contínua.

• Apoiar squads de produto e infraestrutura na análise de performance e comportamento dos sistemas.

• Desenvolver e disseminar boas práticas de observabilidade nos ciclos de desenvolvimento e operações.

• Conduzir treinamentos técnicos sobre métricas, rastreamento e diagnóstico de aplicações.

• Evoluir continuamente o processo de detecção proativa e resposta rápida a falhas.

• Apoiar auditorias e relatórios técnicos com dados precisos de disponibilidade e incidentes.


Principais conhecimentos:

• Observabilidade ponta a ponta com Zabbix, Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) e Dynatrace.

• Criação, padronização e manutenção de dashboards operacionais, executivos e técnicos.

• Implementação e monitoramento de SLIs, SLOs e SLAs alinhados a objetivos de negócio.

• Rastreamento distribuído (Distributed Tracing) com Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger ou similares.

• Monitoramento de ambientes em nuvem (AWS, Azure) e conteinerizados (Kubernetes, Docker).

• Integração com ferramentas de alerta e resposta a incidentes: Opsgenie, PagerDuty, VictorOps.

• Automação de processos operacionais e scripts para coleta e análise de dados (Python, Shell, PowerShell).

• Participação ativa em war rooms, execução de post-mortems e condução de RCA (Root Cause Analysis).

• Criação e manutenção de documentação operacional (runbooks, playbooks, checklists).

• Colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e produto para antecipação de riscos e padronização de visibilidade.


Perfil acadêmico e habilidades:

• Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência sólida e comprovada como SRE, Observability Engineer ou DevOps com foco em monitoramento.

• Domínio técnico de Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace em ambientes de missão crítica.

• Forte entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e métricas operacionais.

• Vivência com rastreamento distribuído e integração de logs/métricas em pipelines CI/CD.

• Capacidade de correlacionar dados de observabilidade com impacto no negócio.

• Experiência com cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP) e orquestração de contêineres (Kubernetes).

• Fluência em automação com linguagens como Python, Shell Script, Go ou similares.

• Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo com múltiplas áreas.

• Visão sistêmica, senso crítico e iniciativa para liderar projetos de melhoria contínua. Qualificações Desejáveis:

• Certificações em observabilidade e confiabilidade: Dynatrace Associate, Zabbix Certified, Elastic Observability, SRE Foundation.

• Conhecimento em Prometheus, Grafana, Loki e OpenTelemetry.

• Experiência com Chaos Engineering e validação de resiliência.

• Participação em incidentes críticos com liderança técnica na resposta.

• Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços e desafios de visibilidade em ambientes distribuídos.

• Familiaridade com práticas de FinOps e eficiência operacional em observabilidade.

• Participação em comunidades técnicas de SRE, DevOps e observabilidade.

This person will be responsible for moving qualified opportunities through the sales cycle, keeping deals on track, improving conversion from meetings to revenue, and ensuring internal teams stay aligned around client expectations and business outcomes. 


The ideal candidate brings senior-level sales experience , preferably 10+ years , with experience working with the U.S. market or U.S.-based clients . Experience in nearshore services  is preferred, as is experience helping grow a company from approximately $4M–$5M to $15M–$20M USD  in revenue. 


Key Responsibilities  


  • Own the full sales cycle from qualified opportunity to close, ensuring deals progress consistently and do not stall. 
  • Maintain clear next steps for every active deal and ensure consistent follow-up with prospects and clients. 
  • Partner with outbound efforts to convert meetings into revenue and improve conversion rates. 
  • Drive consistent client communication and follow-up to maintain momentum and build long-term relationships. 
  • Own day-to-day commercial and operational coordination across Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery. 
  • Hold Talent Acquisition, Account Management, and Delivery teams accountable to timelines, quality standards, and client expectations. 
  • Maintain CRM accuracy, pipeline visibility, and updated deal information. 
  • Monitor active opportunities, identify risks, and drive corrective actions when deals or delivery timelines are at risk. 
  • Provide weekly reporting on pipeline, revenue, and operational performance. 
  • Highlight risks, blockers, and opportunities for improvement across sales and delivery operations. 
  • Help ensure the team remains focused on revenue generation, client satisfaction, and execution quality. 
  • Support revenue growth by improving sales execution, operational follow-through, and conversion from meetings to closed business. 


Required Skills  


  • 10+ years of senior sales or commercial leadership experience . 
  • Experience working with the U.S. market or U.S.-based clients . 
  • Strong sales and revenue mindset, with the ability to own opportunities from qualified lead to close. 
  • Experience managing sales pipelines, client follow-up, and deal progression. 
  • Strong CRM discipline, including accurate pipeline tracking and clear next-step management. 
  • Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams and hold stakeholders accountable. 
  • Strong communication skills with both clients and internal team members. 
  • Ability to identify stalled deals, operational gaps, or risks and take action to move things forward. 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift. 
  • Comfortable reporting on pipeline, revenue, operational performance, and key risks. 
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability. 
  • Ability to operate at both a strategic and hands-on level, balancing revenue leadership with day-to-day execution. 


Nice-to-Have Skills  


  • Experience in a revenue leadership, sales operations, commercial operations, or CRO-adjacent role. 
  • Experience in nearshore services. 
  • Experience helping grow a company from approximately $4M–$5M to $15M–$20M USD  in revenue. 
  • Experience working with Talent Acquisition, Account Management, or Delivery teams. 
  • Experience improving meeting-to-revenue conversion rates. 
  • Experience managing client relationships in a service-based business environment. 
  • Experience selling services, recruiting solutions, staffing, consulting, or other people-based business solutions. 


Compensation Range


  • Base compensation: $60,000–$100,000 USD
  • Commission: Yes

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a supplyy chain focused company.


Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Content Author Specialist to support the creation, management, and optimization of digital content across our web platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has a strong understanding of content management systems, and is passionate about delivering high-quality user experiences.

Graphic design experience is not required, but candidates with a design background will have an added advantage in enhancing visual content and collaborating effectively with creative teams.


Key Responsibilities

Author, edit, and publish web content using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)

Maintain and update website pages, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with brand standards

Collaborate with UX, marketing, and development teams to implement content strategies

Manage digital assets, including images, videos, and documents within the AEM Digital Asset Manager (DAM)

Ensure content is optimized for performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices

Troubleshoot content issues and provide solutions within AEM

Follow governance standards, workflows, and approval processes for content publishing

Assist with content audits and quality assurance to ensure a seamless user experience


Required Qualifications

Proven experience working with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) as a content author or in a similar role

Strong understanding of content management systems and web publishing workflows

Familiarity with HTML basics and web content structure (no coding required, but helpful)

High attention to detail and strong organizational skills

Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.)

Experience with Figma

ADA Compliance experience a plus

Basic knowledge of graphic design principles (layout, typography, visual hierarchy)

Experience working closely with UX/UI design teams

Understanding of responsive design and mobile-first content strategies

Knowledge of analytics tools or A/B testing platforms

What Sets You Apart

A strong eye for visual detail and user experience

Ability to turn design concepts into polished, web-ready content

Proactive problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn new tools

Cara leitora,

Se você está rolando o LinkedIn há dias vendo as mesmas vagas de sempre...

\"Buscamos profissional proativo com boa comunicação\" \"Requisitos: Excel avançado e experiência na área\" \"Oferecemos: salário compatível com o mercado\"

..e sente que nenhuma dessas vagas te dá vontade de levantar da cadeira e se candidatar...


Para.


Essa aqui é diferente.


Sabe aquela sensação de fazer uma venda e pensar \"eu SABIA que ia fechar\"?


É isso que você vai sentir aqui. Todo dia.


Porque os leads já chegam interessados. Eles viram os resultados no Instagram. Já querem fazer o procedimento. Já estão imaginando como vão ficar. Já pesquisaram sobre harmonização.


O trabalho pesado de gerar desejo? O Instagram já fez.


Só falta uma coisa: alguém que conduza a conversa até o agendamento.


Esse alguém é você.

A clínica entrega o resultado. O Instagram entrega o lead. Você entrega a consulta paga.

Sem você, lead vira só número no direct. Com você, lead vira paciente na agenda, faturamento no caixa, transformação na vida de uma mulher.


SOBRE A CLÍNICA


Somos uma clínica de harmonização facial que transforma a autoestima de mulheres todos os dias.

Nosso Instagram gera interesse. Nossos procedimentos geram resultado. Nossas pacientes geram indicações.

A demanda existe. O desejo existe. A confiança existe.

O que falta é você conectando tudo isso em consultas pagas.

O tipo de pessoa que vê uma notificação no direct e já sente a adrenalina de uma possível conversão.

Que entende que velocidade é conversão - e age de acordo.

Que não manda preço e espera. Manda preço e já prepara o próximo passo.

Que trata \"vou pensar\" como o início da venda, não como o fim.

Que sente satisfação real quando transforma uma conversa difícil em agendamento confirmado.

É quase como se uma closer, uma estrategista e uma organizadora obsessiva tivessem uma filha.

Você tem fome de resultado. E a estrutura pra sustentar isso.


SUA MISSÃO


Transformar seguidores em leads. Transformar leads em consultas pagas. Transformar consultas em pacientes recorrentes.

Seu trabalho é não deixar ninguém escapar do funil.

..mas antes que você fique toda empolgada, vou te interromper aqui...

Porque essa função não é fácil. Ok?


Exige velocidade. Exige organização. Exige resiliência. E exige uma capacidade rara de manter o ritmo intenso dia após dia.

A carga é pesada. O ritmo é acelerado. E a gente só quer quem aguenta o tranco.


NA PRÁTICA, VOCÊ VAI:


● Monitorar o Instagram como um radar: Comentários, DMs, reações, menções. Onde tem interação, tem oportunidade. Você não espera aparecer - você vai buscar.

● Abordar rápido e trazer pro WhatsApp: A rede social é vitrine. O WhatsApp é onde você controla a conversa. Você faz essa ponte em minutos, não em horas.

● Qualificar a necessidade: Entender o que ela quer, qual o momento dela, quais as dúvidas reais. Não é só \"passar informação\" - é descobrir como ajudar ela a decidir.

● Conduzir com estratégia até a consulta PAGA: Você não agenda. Você FECHA. O ciclo só termina quando tem pagamento.

● Confirmar as consultas agendadas: Ligação, mensagem, lembrete. O que for preciso pra garantir que ela apareça. No-show é zero no caixa.

● Follow-up como rotina sagrada:

○ Lead que perguntou e sumiu? Volta nele.

○ Lead que disse \"tá caro\"? Entende a objeção real.

○ Lead que disse \"vou pensar\"? Mantém o relacionamento até ela decidir.

○ Paciente que cancelou? Reagenda.

isso todo dia.

não. Você entende que \"vou pensar\" não é não - é \"me convença\". Você sabe que quem sumiu

Velocidade: Você não deixa lead esfriar. Chegou, você responde. Ponto.

title: Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover)

Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units.

This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions.

The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact
  • Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders.
  • Retention Analysis & Insight
  • Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk.
  • Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement
  • Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month.
  • Salesforce Data Quality & Governance
  • Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn.
  • Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation
  • Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.



Required Qualifications & Experience

Technical & Operational Expertise

  • Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role.
  • Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting.
  • High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs.
  • Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous.

Revenue & Churn Acumen

  • Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business.
  • Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics.
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations.
  • Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.

Why This Role Matters

Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue.

As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

  • A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind.


The Challenges You Will Face:

  • 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule.
  • Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts.


If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let’s talk. Apply now and let’s make a global impact together!

title: Appointment Setter (m/w/d) | Remote | Deutsch
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Appointment Setter (m/w/d) | Remote | Deutsch em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Stell dir vor, du arbeitest von einem Coworking-Space auf Mallorca. Blauer Himmel, Meer, und du buchst gerade den nächsten Termin für dein Team. Das ist kein Urlaub. Das ist dein Job.


Was hinter dieser Stelle steckt

Harucon Ventures skaliert E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Markt mit Google Ads auf ein neues Level. Wir sind kein 08/15-Arbeitgeber, wir bauen ein Team, das remote arbeitet, aber trotzdem zusammen ist.


Und wir haben entschieden, dass \"zusammen\" auch bedeutet: einmal im Jahr gemeinsam an einem der schönsten Orte Europas.


Dieses Jahr? Mallorca. Nächstes Jahr? Portugal. Immer anders. Immer unvergesslich.


Deine Rolle

Du bist der erste Kontakt zu potenziellen Kunden. Über LinkedIn und Social Media baust du echte Gespräche auf, qualifizierst Interessenten und buchst Ersttermine für unser Closing-Team. Kein Cold Calling. Reines Chat-Outreach, mit Skripten und Prozessen, die funktionieren.


Du musst nichts erfinden. Du kriegst alles an die Hand, was du brauchst, und wirst von Anfang an eng begleitet.


Was du mitbringst

  • Deutsch auf höchstem Niveau, schriftlich wie mündlich (C2 oder vergleichbar), da unser gesamter Markt DACH ist und jede Nachricht perfekt klingen muss
  • Du bist auf LinkedIn und Social Media zuhause und weißt, wie man dort echte Gespräche führt
  • Verlässlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung
  • Sales-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Einstellungskriterium


Was du bekommst

Hier verdienst du solide, von Tag eins. Kein \"lass uns erstmal schauen\", kein Vertrösten. Du kennst dein Fixgehalt, bevor du auch nur eine Nachricht schreibst, und es liegt deutlich über dem Marktdurchschnitt.

Dazu kommt ein Bonus für jeden gebuchten Termin. Dein Einsatz bestimmt direkt, was am Monatsende auf dem Konto landet.

Und weil wir keine Stunden zählen, sondern Ergebnisse: Wer liefert, hat bei uns maximale Freiheit. Kein Micro-Management, keine Kontrolle, keine Rechtfertigungen. Du bist erwachsen, wir behandeln dich so.


Außerdem:

  • 100 % remote, du arbeitest wo und wann du willst
  • Jährliches Team-Coworking auf Mallorca und Portugal, abwechselnd, alle Kosten übernommen
  • Alle Tools, Skripte und Prozesse werden dir gestellt, du startest nicht bei null
  • Schnelles Onboarding, enge Begleitung, kein Micro-Management
  • Ein ambitioniertes Team, das sich gegenseitig weiterbringt
  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive, wer hier gut ist, wächst mit uns


Wie du dich bewirbst

Kein Lebenslauf, keine lange Bewerbung. Schick uns einfach eine kurze Nachricht direkt hier über LinkedIn und erzähl uns in zwei, drei Sätzen, wer du bist und warum dich diese Stelle reizt. Wir melden uns schnell.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Summary


The Data Analyst supports the company’s data and analytics initiatives by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data solutions that provide actionable insights to leadership and stakeholders. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, meaningful visualizations and analysis to support data-driven decision-making. The Data Analyst partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and usability. This position contributes to advanced analytics, forecasting, and continuous improvement of reporting capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Build and maintain data models, custom measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query.
  • Analyze and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and reporting.
  • Present insights, trends, and findings clearly to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Develop predictive models and apply forecasting and statistical techniques to support business planning.
  • Leverage Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric to support advanced analytics solutions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and deliver analytics solutions aligned with business needs.
  • Educate and support teams on data concepts, reporting tools, and analytics best practices.
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities assigned due to business needs.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract, transform, and analyze data efficiently.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric.
  • Ability to present complex data clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of predictive analytics, forecasting, machine learning, and statistical analysis techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Passion for data visualization, continuous learning, and process improvement.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills.

Education, Training, and Experience

  • High school diploma required; college degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related role required.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI required.
  • Demonstrated experience developing dashboards, reports, and data models required.
  • Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and analytics tools preferred.
  • Experience presenting data insights to leadership and non-technical audiences preferred.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

FirstIgnite develops AI-powered tools designed to support universities in key areas such as Tech Transfer, Corporate Relations, Advancement, Career Development, and Research Development. These tools empower universities to expand their initiatives and streamline operations effectively. FirstIgnite is dedicated to helping academic institutions grow and thrive through innovative technological solutions, making a meaningful impact in the education sector.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Data Engineer. The Data Engineer, will lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data systems focused on acquiring, structuring, and integrating diverse datasets from external and internal sources. This role will be responsible for building reliable data acquisition pipelines, including crawling, scraping, API ingestion, data mining, enrichment, and ETL workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into accurate, usable data for FirstIgnite’s platform.


Qualifications

  • Lead the architecture, development, and optimization of scalable data pipelines for patents, grants, clinical trials, publications, labs, and firmographic sources.
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows on AWS using Glue (PySpark), Lambda, S3, and RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Explore and implement complementary data storage solutions as needed.
  • Apply machine learning and LLM-based techniques to extract, structure, and enrich data at scale.
  • Ensure data integrity, security, accuracy, and governance across all systems.
  • Implement tools for data exploration, visualization, and actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to drive AI-driven innovation.
  • Evaluate emerging AI/ML techniques and tools to enhance platform capabilities.
  • Maintain version control, CI/CD pipelines, and reproducible workflows for the data engineering team.


Requirements

  • Strong programming expertise in Python, with experience building production data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS data services (Glue/PySpark, Lambda, S3, RDS PostgreSQL, SSM) or equivalent cloud data stacks.
  • Strong experience with external data acquisition, including building and maintaining crawlers, scrapers, API integrations, and data mining workflows that turn messy public or semi-public sources into reliable, structured datasets. This includes handling rate limits, source changes, deduplication, validation, enrichment, and pipeline monitoring.
  • Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs, ETL processes, and data integration strategies.
  • Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI-enhanced data applications.
  • Strong analytical skills, including evaluating trade-offs of data ingestion and storage methods.
  • Leadership experience managing data engineering or AI teams in SaaS or tech environments.
  • Solid knowledge of version control (Git) and CI/CD practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive projects from conception to deployment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with web scraping at scale (Firecrawl or similar).
  • LLM-based data extraction and prompt engineering for structured output.
  • Data quality instrumentation and observability for pipelines.


As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you’re proud of.


Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: \"Engenheiro de dados #997215\"
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para \"Engenheiro de dados #997215\" em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Conhecimento técnico esperado:

  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes de nuvem - Azure, AWS ou GCP;
  • Domínio e aplicação de Arquiteturas Lakehouse;
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de Data Lakes;
  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura de Event-Driven (EDA)
  • Conhecimento em Mensageria (Kafka, Eventhubs, SQS, ServiceBus ou PubSub)
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de integração de dados (StreamSets ou Azure Data Factory);
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento de dados (ex.: Spark, Scala, Databricks);
  • Conhecimento sobre bases de dados relacionais (ex.: PostgreSQL) e não-relacionais (ex.: MongoDB);
  • Capacidade de analisar e modelar bases de dados;
  • Conhecer fluxos e ferramentas de CI/CD;
  • Domínio da metodologia Ágil;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de MicroServies.


No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Talent Acquisition Specialist

Role Overview

We are seeking a proactive and adaptable Talent Acquisition Specialist with experience recruiting across multiple industries and mid-level roles , including global and remote hiring.

This role is critical to building a high-quality, scalable team. You will partner closely with hiring managers across departments to identify talent needs, run efficient hiring processes, and bring in candidates who align with both skill requirements and company culture.


Key Responsibilities


Full-Cycle Recruiting

  • Own end-to-end recruitment for mid-level roles across functions (Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, etc.)
  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and candidate profiles
  • Manage job postings across platforms and optimize for visibility and quality
  • Screen candidates, conduct initial interviews, and coordinate hiring processes
  • Drive structured and efficient interview workflows


Global & Remote Hiring

  • Source and recruit candidates across different regions and time zones
  • Manage remote hiring processes and candidate experience end-to-end
  • Navigate international talent pools and adapt sourcing strategies accordingly
  • Ensure smooth coordination across distributed teams


Sourcing & Pipeline Building

  • Proactively source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and other channels
  • Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for recurring roles
  • Identify and engage passive candidates
  • Continuously improve sourcing strategies based on role and market conditions


Process & Operations

  • Track candidate progress and maintain organized pipelines
  • Improve recruiting workflows, documentation, and systems
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Support reporting on hiring metrics and pipeline health


Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–5+ years of experience in recruiting or talent acquisition
  • Experience hiring across multiple industries or functions
  • Proven experience recruiting mid-level roles end-to-end
  • Experience with remote and global hiring
  • Strong sourcing skills (LinkedIn, outbound, etc.)
  • Excellent organizational and pipeline management skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities


What Makes You Exceptional

  • You can quickly understand different roles across functions and industries
  • You are resourceful and know how to find talent in competitive markets
  • You bring structure and clarity to hiring processes
  • You are highly responsive and keep both candidates and hiring managers aligned
  • You balance speed with quality in hiring decisions
  • You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving, evolving environment


Why This Role Matters

As Carepod grows, hiring the right people efficiently becomes a key driver of success.

  • This role ensures we build strong teams across functions and geographies by bringing in high-quality talent and maintaining a structured, scalable hiring process. Your work will directly impact team performance, company culture, and our ability to grow effectively.


Requirements added by the job poster

• 3+ years of Staffing and Recruiting experience

• 3+ years of work experience with 360 Recruitment

title: Video Editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Editor em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.


Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. We operate in a dynamic environment where collaboration drives ideation and where you will help shape the ever-growing media landscape as we know it. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.


You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

  • Edit audio and video for podcast, YouTube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content.
  • Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques.
  • Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product.
  • Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, YouTube, TikTok).
  • Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement.
  • Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience.
  • Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity
  • Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone
  • and more...


Job Requirements

You Have...

  • The ability to speak advanced to fluent English
  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content.
  • Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations.
  • Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Estagiário em Operação & Performance
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Estagiário em Operação & Performance em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Muito além de uma consultoria, somos um ecossistema de soluções em gestão e estruturação de negócios que transformarão o futuro do turismo. Temos 4 grupos de soluções para as áreas de hospitalidade, entretenimento e destinos turísticos:


  • Estratégia & Desenvolvimento: Estruturação e viabilidade de novos negócios; 
  • Operação & Performance: Asset Management, eficiência operacional e novas receitas 
  • Revenue Management & Analytics: inteligência de mercado e análise de tendências; 
  • Produto & Inovação: Novos produtos, marcas e experiências. 


Assim como a coruja, que inspirou o nosso nome, utilizamos nossa sabedoria e visão aguçada para alçar voos cada vez mais altos. Trabalhamos com verdade e nos envolvemos em projetos em que acreditamos, pois sabemos que o êxito é maior quando alinhamos interesses com todos que caminham com a gente.

Aqui, prezamos por um ambiente de trabalho leve, flexível, ético, inovador, íntegro e que valoriza a autonomia de cada colaborador. Todas as opiniões e sugestões são muito bem-vindas e respeitadas. Buscamos quem partilha desses princípios e acredita ser possível fazer diferente e ir além.

O SEU DIA A DIA COM A GENTE  

·      Atuação em projetos de Asset Management hoteleiro, Revenue Management e Analytics; 

·      Apoio à análise de performance dos empreendimentos e consolidação de reports; 

·      Suporte à governança com clientes, incluindo reuniões periódicas e acompanhamento de planos de ação; 

·      Envolvimento na estruturação e implantação de áreas de Revenue Management; 

·      Desenvolvimento de dashboards e insights analíticos; 

·      Análise de indicadores e pesquisas de benchmarking; 

·      Organização e participação em viagens de campo (quando possível). 

PERFIL DO CANDIDATO  

·   Cursando hotelaria, turismo, administração, economia ou áreas correlatas a partir do 5º período e, o mais importante, se interessar pelos setores em que atuamos; 

·      Raciocínio lógico, boa capacidade analítica e excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita; 

·      Proatividade e disposição para aprender; 

·      Organização e atenção a detalhes; 

·      Inglês avançado; 

·      Desejável conhecimento das ferramentas Microsoft Excel, Power Point e plataformas de IA. 


BENEFÍCIOS  

·      Bolsa-auxílio; 

·      Seguro de vida; 

·      Vale refeição; 

·      Auxílio transporte; 

·      Treinamentos de capacitação com materiais de aulas ministradas em cursos de pós-graduação.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Pleno | Python, PySpark, Kafka e Dados em Tempo Real
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro(a) de Dados Pleno | Python, PySpark, Kafka e Dados em Tempo Real em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No entretenimento digital, segundos importam. Pagamentos que travam custam caro.

A LBPay nasceu para eliminar esse problema. Como Instituição de Pagamento autorizada pelo Banco Central, atuamos em ambientes de alta exigência como iGaming, e-commerce e operações de alta frequência — onde estabilidade, velocidade e confiabilidade são inegociáveis.


Sobre a posição

Buscamos uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados, desenvolvendo pipelines escaláveis e garantindo a disponibilidade de informações críticas para o negócio.


Você trabalhará com grandes volumes de dados transacionais, contribuindo para a qualidade, confiabilidade e performance das soluções que apoiam áreas estratégicas da empresa. Procuramos alguém com perfil hands-on, senso de ownership e interesse em atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais de engenharia de dados e alto impacto no negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando Python, PySpark e SQL.
  • Construir e evoluir fluxos de ingestão de dados baseados em eventos e streaming.
  • Implementar transformações, deduplicação e tratamento de dados nas camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold.
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados processados.
  • Criar e otimizar tabelas e visões analíticas para consumo por dashboards e aplicações de negócio.
  • Trabalhar com armazenamento em Parquet e ambientes S3-compatible.
  • Participar da evolução de schemas e contratos de dados entre sistemas produtores e consumidores.
  • Desenvolver testes automatizados e mecanismos de validação para proteção de indicadores financeiros.
  • Monitorar pipelines e investigar inconsistências ou discrepâncias de dados.
  • Apoiar implantações e operação de soluções em Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Compliance, Tesouraria e Tecnologia na construção de soluções orientadas a dados.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prática atuando como Engenheiro(a) de Dados ou em funções equivalentes.
  • Domínio de Python aplicado à engenharia de dados.
  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL avançado.
  • Experiência com Apache Spark / PySpark para processamento e transformação de dados.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas de dados em camadas (Bronze, Silver e Gold).
  • Experiência trabalhando com arquivos Parquet e armazenamento em nuvem ou object storage.
  • Conhecimento de Docker e noções práticas de Kubernetes.
  • Experiência com testes automatizados, versionamento Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com mensageria e streaming de dados, especialmente Kafka ou tecnologias similares.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Apache Pulsar.
  • Conhecimento de DuckDB e PostgreSQL para workloads analíticos.
  • Conhecimento sobre PIX, Open Finance, SPI, MED ou regulamentações do BACEN.
  • Experiência com observabilidade utilizando Prometheus, Datadog, Grafana ou Metabase.
  • Conhecimento em GitOps, ArgoCD, Helm ou Kustomize.
  • Experiência com Protobuf e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

Modalidade: Remoto

Contratação: PJ

title: PL Desenvolvimento Salesforce
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para PL Desenvolvimento Salesforce em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

description:
